definition: Streamlit turns Python scripts into interactive web apps — ideal for data dashboards and AI demos.
details: Created by Adrien Treuille, Thiago Teixeira and Amanda Kelly in 2019; acquired by Snowflake in 2022.

explainer.lead: How to install Streamlit, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.
explainer.createdBy: Adrien Treuille, Thiago Teixeira, Amanda Kelly; Snowflake.
explainer.inAi: Build a chat UI or model playground in pure Python in minutes.
explainer.jsNote: Streamlit is a Python library with no official JavaScript or TypeScript package; call it from a Python service if your app is written in JavaScript.
